intro: Kobold Camp Cleanup is an early military task assigned by Marshal McBride to newly arrived recruits in Northshire Valley. The mission directs volunteers to cull the kobold vermin lurking in the northern woods, attempting to keep the aggressive subterranean scavengers from overwhelming the abbey grounds. It serves as an initiate's first true test in defending the borders of the Kingdom of Stormwind.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your first task is one of cleansing, friend. A clan of kobolds have infested the woods to the north. Go there and fight the kobold vermin you find. Reduce their numbers so that we may one day drive them from Northshire.

clips.title: Progress
paras: How goes the hunting, friend? Have you found and defeated those vermin?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, citizen. Those kobolds are thieves and cowards, but in large numbers they pose a threat to us. And the humans of Stormwind do not need another threat.
For defeating them, you have my gratitude.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
